## Step

`res://assets/scripts/steps/Step.gd`, extends [`Node`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_node.html)

One step on a timeline, such as a windup, a turn or a swing: a child node of what owns the timeline (pawn spec 16.7).

A [`StepTimeline`](#steptimeline) decides when steps start: at a tick, when another step starts or ends, or on a condition, so several can run at once and one step can run in several entries. Extend it and override `enter()`, `tick()` (RUNNING, DONE or FAILED) and `exit()`; the owner ends when no step with `keeps_owner_running` is left and nothing is due. A step started during a tick enters at once and gets its first tick on the next. Abilities use [`AbilityStep`](../abilities/REFERENCE.md#abilitystep), which adds cancel windows and ending on release.
Rollback: whether it runs and its count live in its timeline's state, which its owner rolls back; any other state must be listed in `get_rollback_properties()`, because a rollback restores values without calling `enter()` or `exit()`.

### Settings and properties

- `length_ticks: int` = `0`: How long it runs, in ticks at 60 a second (converted for the match's tick rate). 0: until tick() says DONE.
- `keeps_owner_running: bool` = `true`: On: its owner keeps running while this step does. Off for a step that only goes along (a turn through a swing): once only such steps are left, the owner's run ends and they stop with "done".
- `running: bool`: True while it runs. Worked out from its timeline's state, which rolls back.
- `step_ticks: int`: Ticks counted since it started (those `counts_this_tick()` allowed); in `tick()`, the ticks before this one. 0 when not running.
- `checks_release: bool` = `false`: On: its timeline asks `released_now()` each tick. Off (the default), so steps that can't be released cost no call; a subclass that can end on release keeps it up to date.
- `timeline: StepTimeline` = `null`: The timeline it's on, set when the timeline is built.
- `pawn: Pawn` = `null`: The pawn its owner belongs to.

### Constants

- `Status.RUNNING = 0`: still going
- `Status.DONE = 1`: finished: the timeline entries that follow its end start
- `Status.FAILED = 2`: couldn't do its job: the whole run ends

### Functions

- `get_rollback_properties() -> String[]`: The properties on this step that roll back: none by default. A step that keeps more lists them here.
- `length() -> int`: How long it runs, in this match's ticks; 0 if it runs until it says it's done.
- `released_now() -> bool`: True if it should end now, before its tick, with "released" (which starts what follows it, as done does). Never by default; [`AbilityStep`](../abilities/REFERENCE.md#abilitystep) ends when its action is let go.
- `progress() -> float`: How far through its length it is, 0 to 1, with how far the tick driver is toward the next tick, for smooth visuals. 0 with no length.
- `enter() -> void`: Once, when it starts.
- `tick(_dt: float) -> int`: Every tick it runs: RUNNING to go on, DONE when finished (what follows it in the timeline starts), FAILED to end the whole run.
- `exit(_reason: String) -> void`: Once, when it stops; reason is "done", "released", "failed" or "cancelled" (its owner ended, an interrupt, or another step).
- `counts_this_tick() -> bool`: Whether this tick counts toward length_ticks. Always by default; a windup waiting for a turn says no.
- `setup() -> void`: Once, when its timeline is built: for working out settings (an input bit, say), not for state.

## StepTimeline

`res://assets/scripts/steps/StepTimeline.gd`, extends [`RefCounted`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_refcounted.html)

Runs an owner's [`Step`](#step) children on a timeline of [`TimelineEntry`](../abilities/REFERENCE.md#timelineentry) rules (pawn spec 16.7, ability spec 6.2).

Each ability owns one (and each AI behaviour will). Entries start at a tick, when another entry starts or ends (with a delay), or on a condition; steps end on their length or when they say done; several run at once, and one step can run in several entries. The timeline's state is four numbers per entry (`state`), which its owner rolls back as one value.
The owner (the host) is told what happens through these methods, which it must have:

```gdscript
_timeline_state_written()                  # state changed: push it for rollback
_timeline_step_started(step)               # a step entered
_timeline_step_finished(step, reason)      # a step exited
_timeline_runaway()                        # too many starts in one tick: end the run
```

Conditions are asked about the host (`AbilityCondition.holds()`).

### Settings and properties

- `steps: Step[]` = `[]`: Its steps in tree order.
- `entries: TimelineEntry[]` = `[]`: The entries it runs: the source given to `build()`, plus a manual entry for each step none names.
- `state: PackedInt32Array` = `PackedInt32Array()`: Four numbers per entry: the tick it started, the tick it ended (-1: not yet), why it ended (`TimelineEntry.Reason`, 0 none) and where its step's count starts (the start, moved on by ticks that didn't count). A step that only waits out its length changes nothing while it runs. Set it only to load a saved state, then call `loaded()`.
- `started_at: int` = `-1`: The tick the current run began, for entries that start at a tick.
- `host: Object` = `null`: The owner it reports to; see the class description.
- `owner_name: String` = `""`: For warnings: the owner's name.

### Constants

- `MAX_STARTS_PER_TICK = 32`: The most steps one timeline may start in one tick, a guard against steps that start and stop each other in a loop. Past it, starts are refused, the host is told to end its run, and it warns once.
- `Result.RUNNING = 0`: a step that keeps the owner running runs, or an entry is still due
- `Result.DONE = 1`: nothing left: every step has stopped with "done"
- `Result.FAILED = 2`: a step failed: every step has stopped with "failed"

### Functions

- `build(new_steps: Step[], source: TimelineEntry[]) -> void`: Works out the entries from these steps and source entries (empty: the steps one after another in tree order) and checks them once: entries naming a step it doesn't have, an "after" naming no entry, labels used twice, and entries that follow each other in a loop. Then each step's `Step.setup()`.
- `has_steps() -> bool`: True if it has steps.
- `begin(start_tick: int) -> void`: A run begins on this tick: clears the state and starts the entries due at once.
- `run(dt: float, elapsed: int) -> int`: Every tick of a run, covering `elapsed` ticks (more than 1 for a pawn on a load step): ticks each running step in entry order, then starts the entries whose rules now hold. A step done or released starts what follows it; one that fails stops them all.
- `end(reason: String = "cancelled") -> void`: Stops every running step with this reason, and puts back the step values its entries changed.
- `loaded() -> void`: After a rollback set `state`: the running entries' values go back onto their steps.
- `start_step(step: Step) -> void`: Starts a step from code, as a bespoke script does (ability spec 6.4): its first entry not running, started again if it already ran. Steps no entry names have a manual entry for this.
- `stop_step(step: Step, reason: String = "cancelled") -> void`: Stops a running step, passing the reason ("done", "released", "failed", "cancelled") to its `Step.exit()`.
- `running_entry_of(step: Step) -> int`: The entry this step runs in now, or -1.
- `step_ticks_of(step: Step) -> int`: Ticks a running step has counted: since it started, less the ticks that didn't count (`Step.counts_this_tick()`). Inside its own `Step.tick()`, the ticks before this one. 0 when not running.
- `start_entry(e: int) -> void`: Starts this entry now: its values onto its step, then the step's enter(). Rules call it; code can too.
- `stop_entry(e: int, reason: String = "cancelled") -> void`: Stops this running entry with this reason ("done", "released", "failed" or "cancelled").
- `get_running_step_names() -> PackedStringArray`: The names of the steps running now, in tree order. For readouts and debug tools.
- `steps_after(step: Step) -> Step[]`: The steps whose entries start when an entry of this step ends: what comes after it, for visuals (a windup's sweep).
- `step_before(step: Step) -> Step`: The step whose end starts this step's first entry, or null: what came before it, for visuals (a recovery's sweep).

## MoveStep

`res://assets/scripts/steps/movement/MoveStep.gd`, extends [`Step`](#step)

The base of steps that walk the pawn along a nav path: holds a [`PathFollower`](../navigation/REFERENCE.md#pathfollower) and writes its direction into the host's input.

[`MoveToStep`](#movetostep) extends it; Follow and KeepAwayFrom will (pawn spec 16.7). Its host is whatever owns its timeline and has an `input` (an [`InputCommand`](../controllers/REFERENCE.md#inputcommand)) its steps write: a [`ControllerStepHost`](../controllers/REFERENCE.md#controllerstephost) today, an AI behaviour from step 7. Each tick it writes the follower's direction into the input's move and ORs in a link's action (`steer()`). The settings below are copied into the follower when the timeline is built; in code, change `follower` itself.
Rollback: the follower doesn't roll back yet. The player's host runs on the owner's machine only, whose input is what rolls back.

### Settings and properties

- `corner_reached_distance: float` = `0.5`: How close, in metres, the pawn must get to a corner of the path before it heads for the next one (measured flat).
- `arrival_distance: float` = `0.3`: How close, in metres, it must get to the end of the path to count as arrived.
- `nav_tier: int` = `0`: Which size of nav to use. 0 is the smallest; t0 builds only tier 0.
- `use_links: bool` = `true`: On, paths may cross links (jumps, drops, placed links). Off for a pawn that can't jump.
- `link_timeout_ticks: int` = `180`: How long the pawn has to cross a link, in ticks at 60 a second, before it finds a new path to the same place.
- `straight_line_without_nav: bool` = `true`: On, with no nav at all (and none being built) it walks in a straight line. Off, that's no way there.
- `pending_retry_ticks: int` = `10`: While waiting for nav to be built, how often it tries again, in ticks at 60 a second.
- `pending_give_up_ticks: int` = `300`: How long it waits for nav to be built or a queued path to come, in ticks at 60 a second, before giving up.
- `follower: PathFollower` = `<unknown>`: The path it follows. Its settings come from the ones above when the timeline is built.

### Functions

- `setup() -> void`
- `enter() -> void`
- `exit(_reason: String) -> void`
- `steer() -> void`: Writes this tick's direction into the host's input, and presses a link's action the path just reached. Call it once per tick, from `Step.tick()`: it moves the follower on.
- `host_input() -> InputCommand`: The input its host's steps write, or null when its host has none.

## MoveToStep

`res://assets/scripts/steps/movement/MoveToStep.gd`, extends [`MoveStep`](#movestep)

Walks the pawn to a point along a nav path: done on arriving, failed when there's no way there (pawn spec 16.7's MoveTo).

Set `goal` before it starts (a timeline entry's values, or code). With no nav at all it walks a straight line; while nav is still being built it waits, standing. The player's click-to-move runs one on its [`ControllerStepHost`](../controllers/REFERENCE.md#controllerstephost).

### Settings and properties

- `goal: Vector3` = `Vector3(0, 0, 0)`: Where it walks to.

### Functions

- `enter() -> void`
- `tick(_dt: float) -> int`
